design_gotchas.title: Mandatory Feedforward Capacitor Cf Across R1 Prevents Loop Oscillation
design_gotchas.detail: Section 8.2.2.4 stresses that even with internal compensation, an external feedforward capacitor Cf across R1 (setting fz ≈ 8 kHz via Cf = 1/(2*pi*R1*fz)) is mandatory for stability. Omitting Cf when swapping from PFM boost regulators such as TPS61040 can cause instability.

design_gotchas.title: 'X' (1.6 MHz) vs 'Y' (600 kHz) Option Ordering Trap and Higher RthetaJA
design_gotchas.detail: LM2733XMF/NOPB (marking S52A) switches at 1.6 MHz (87% min Dmax, 2.1 mA switching Iq) whereas LM2733YMF/NOPB (marking S52B) switches at 600 kHz (93% min Dmax, 1.1 mA switching Iq, better for extreme > 30 V boost ratios). Also note LM2733 lists 210°C/W RthetaJA vs 166.3°C/W on LM27313.

design_gotchas.title: Select Schottky Diode Rating to Match 40 V High-Voltage Output Margin
design_gotchas.detail: When using LM2733XMF/NOPB to boost above 25 V (up to ~38 V below the 40 V SW abs max), upgrade the external Schottky diode to a >= 40 V part (e.g., MBR0540) and verify peak ringing does not exceed 40 V on Pin 1 (SW).

design_gotchas.title: Switch Current Limit Derates With Duty Cycle and SHDN Must Not Float
design_gotchas.detail: The 1.0 A minimum (1.5 A typ) switch current limit applies only at duty cycles <= 50% and rolls off at high boost ratios (Fig. 26 p.15). Tie SHDN to VIN via a 47-100 kOhm pull-up (never exceed VIN + 0.3 V or leave floating).

typical_use_cases: High-voltage 24 V to 36 V OLED/LCD bias, piezoelectric actuator, or photodiode bias from 3.3 V/5 V/12 V bus
Pin-compatible higher-voltage (40 V SW) and higher-current (1.0 A min) upgrade candidate over LM27313XMF/NOPB and TPS61040DBVR
Compact SOT-23-5 fixed-1.6 MHz series white-LED driver for up to 10 LEDs in series
engineering_summary: The LM2733XMF/NOPB is a fixed-frequency 1.6 MHz ('X' option) current-mode non-synchronous boost converter in SOT-23-5 (DBV) integrating a 40 V, 1.0 A minimum (1.5 A typ at D <= 50%) DMOS switch across a 2.7 V to 14.0 V input range. It matches the exact 5-pin SOT-23 pinout and 1.230 V feedback voltage of LM27313XMF/NOPB and TPS61040DBVR while offering higher voltage headroom (40 V vs 30 V SW) and current limit, at the expense of 2.1 mA switching Iq and 210°C/W RthetaJA. Confirm mandatory Cf compensation, 40 V Schottky diode sizing, and thermal derating against the official TI datasheet before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.3 confirmed DBV 5-pin SOT-23 Top View pinout (1=SW, 2=GND, 3=FB, 4=SHDN, 5=VIN) with no exposed pad and 40 V SW abs max rating.

300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.1 confirmed 5-12 V boost Typical Application (L=10 uH, Cf=220 pF, Cout=4.7 uF) and ~89% peak efficiency for 'X' 1.6 MHz version.
